correctness.rationale: Every finite-dimensional weighted Boolean-product Laplacian is diagonalized exactly by Walsh characters, yielding the stated resolvent return. Cayley identity and positive Markov resolvent show off-diagonal positivity. Strict convexity proves Schur majorization of the return, strict monotonicity transfers it to crossing times. A random-deletion coupling strictly orders binomial sample-mean resolvents. Exact second and fourth moments and a sixth-moment remainder control yield the sharp two corrections, and exact denominator clearing proves the two-rate cubic. All quantifiers include zero-rate and fixed-total boundaries; 848 standalone finite checks corroborate, not substitute for, analytic proofs.

value.rationale: The exact sharp positivity step is a genuine design-relevant invariant of mass-preserving diffusion integrators. The theorem identifies the unique fixed-budget worst-case rate profile, gives a strict order of all anisotropic profiles, produces the first two finite-dimension corrections for exponentially large state spaces, and identifies an unbounded degeneracy limit. It is not simply a single numerical cutoff or a general Cayley identity already in prior literature.
